headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: The management reaffirmed historical guidance for full-year seasonality, projecting second-half operations to deliver approximately 55% of full-year consolidated revenues and 60% of full-year consolidated EBITDA, supported by favorable wedding, retail, and corporate MICE demand cycles across major commercial centers.

We have broadly maintained our earnings estimates for FY27E/FY28E and maintain BUY rating on the stock with a TP of Rs158, assigning 15x EV/EBITDA to FY28E.  Good show on operating parameters: Consolidated revenue from operations increased 18% YoY to Rs3.6bn, supported by 8.1% ARR increase to Rs6,751 and 633 bps occupancy expansion to 76.1% over Q2FY26.
EBITDA rose 22.2% YoY to Rs1,597Mn with margins expanding 152 bps YoY to 44.2%.
Total management fees rose 19.0% YoY to Rs408Mn in Q2 FY27, while total network revenue expanded 22.7% YoY to Rs5,730Mn.
valuation: We have broadly maintained our earnings estimates for FY27E/FY28E and maintain BUY rating on the stock with a TP of Rs158, assigning 15x EV/EBITDA to FY28E.  Good show on operating parameters: Consolidated revenue from operations increased 18% YoY to Rs3.6bn, supported by 8.1% ARR increase to Rs6,751 and 633 bps occupancy expansion to 76.1% over Q2FY26.
watch: The operational footprint expanded to 12,131 rooms across 138 hotels by adding 8 managed properties (523 rooms) and deflagging 5 non-compliant hotels (338 rooms) in Q2 FY27; the total pipeline reached 11,930 keys across 147 hotels, bringing total inventory to 24,061 keys.
Further, the managements’ robust outlook on inventory addition and balance sheet strengthening through debt repayment is encouraging.
